title: A topic's outcome, then at most one recommended action
situation: 0097 counted a decision taken in the turn as a topic's one action and failed any separate follow-on, so approving examples and then recommending the build counted as two actions, though conclusion then one action is exactly the ordering 0078 asks for; most refusals of the withdrawn bottom-line guard were of that kind.
decision: Per topic a reply gives its outcome first, what was found, decided or done in the turn included, and then at most one recommended action, none where nothing remains for anyone; acts already taken are outcomes, never actions, and only what the reply asks of someone next counts as the action. Support states facts and reasons, never instructions (0100). The rebinding to agents 20's history (0097(2)) stands.
consequences: The ordering examples and their rubrics carried into cut 7 are revised to this reading.
